parazoa.definition:
n multicellular organisms having less-specialized cells than in the Metazoa; comprises the single phylum Porifera
n primitive multicellular marine animal whose porous body is supported by a fibrous skeletal framework; usually occurs in sessile colonies

parazoan.definition: n primitive multicellular marine animal whose porous body is supported by a fibrous skeletal framework; usually occurs in sessile colonies
parazoan.translation: n. 侧生动物(即海绵动物或多孔动物)
